Freelancer.com · Software Engineer · 2021–2023

Chat suggestions for freelancers

Built full-stack features as an engineer to test marketplace hypotheses, including chat suggestions that help freelancers win more work.

  • Engineering
  • Marketplace
  • A/B testing

The problem

Freelancers often lose a project in the first few messages with a client. Could we help them respond better and faster?

What I did

  • Built the full-stack feature behind an A/B test to validate the hypothesis.
  • Pushed a shift-left mindset with QA so edge cases were caught early instead of turning into scope creep.

The outcome

This is where I learned to think like a PM: start with the hypothesis, then build only enough to test it.
